title: Forgot password says the reset link was sent on a deployment with no email service
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Found in a real-user walkthrough of the development flow, asked for by the maintainer: 「你站在真实用户实际使用的角度完整的走一遍具体的开发流程，再看一下还有什么问题」 (2026-11-04).

## What a customer sees

A fresh self-hosted deployment has no email service until someone configures one. A member who forgets their password enters their address and reads 「我们已将密码重置链接发送至 colleague@example.test，请检查您的收件箱。」 No mail is sent, and they wait for a message that never comes. The invitation path on the same server tells the truth: 「此服务器未配置邮件，因此没有发出任何邮件。」

## Measured

| Step | Result | Where |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Submit the forgot password form with no email service | The success screen above | Published 18.3.0, `os start` on a fresh database |
| `POST /api/v1/auth/request-password-reset` | 200, `{"status":true,"message":"If this email exists in our system, check your email for the reset link"}` | `main` `63b86b385d` |
| Server side with no transport | Throws `Password-reset email could not be sent…`, so it reaches the log only | `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-auth-instance.ts:462` |
| The text | `successDescription`, an affirmative "sent" | `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts:2863` |
| `GET /api/v1/auth/config` | Names no email delivery state, so the page cannot tell | `main` `63b86b385d` |

The console on `main` was not run in this check, because the review worktree has no console build. The form and the string were read at that commit.

## Expected

On a deployment with no email transport the page says the reset cannot be sent here and to ask an administrator, who can already set a password from Setup → Users. That statement is about the deployment and not about the address, so the no-account-existence-oracle rule at `ui/packages/auth/src/ForgotPasswordForm.tsx:221` still holds: known and unknown addresses read the same.

With a transport configured the behavior stays as it is. The English default also says "Check your email", so the fix covers every locale.
